Definition: from G473 and G2036; to refute or deny:--gainsay, say against.
BiblicalUsage: Jesus promises His disciples a mouth and wisdom which all their adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist. The word means to speak against, to deny or refute, and here the promise is that no adversary will be able to do it.
TheologicalSignificance: One promise about gainsaying carries no doctrine of its own; its comfort is Jesus', that the wisdom He gives cannot be answered by its enemies.
